newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-GREECE LOSE TOP SPOT AFTER DEFEAT BY CROATIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREECE LOSE TOP SPOT AFTER DEFEAT BY CROATIA.

text.p: Greece lost their place at the top of group one after losing 1-0 to Croatia in a World Cup qualifier on Wednesday.
Real Madrid's leading scorer Davor Suker netted the only goal in the 74th minute after he had been put through by defender Slaven Bilic.
Denmark took over the top spot on goal difference from Greece after beating Slovenia 4-0. They have 10 points and Croatia nine.
The Croats were the better of the two sides throughout. Several near misses included a shot against the post in the 72nd minute by Zvonimir Boban.
"We are back in the race," Croat coach Miroslav Balazevic said. "We were playing our last card in Greece and played very well."
Greece came closest to scoring in the 23rd minute when Croat goalkeeper Drazen Ladic kept out a fierce header by Theodore Zagorakis following a corner.
